purpose: Frozen paper-derived discriminator for the conditional Taylor-f and rho-hybrid (2,1) pre-NQC amplitudes; no compiled LAL parity claim.
public_sources: Buonanno, Faye and Hinderer, arXiv:1209.6349v2, Eqs. (52)-(53a)

shared_inputs.note: Circular surrogate inputs for isolating a factorized-mode choice, not independently solved EOB states. All three reconstructions receive identical inputs in each row.

expected: Zero-spin Taylor and rho-hybrid amplitudes coincide; equal-mass unequal-spin flux amplitudes coincide and remain nonzero; q4 mixed-spin flux and waveform-path rho-hybrid amplitudes differ, as do rho-hybrid and Taylor-flux amplitudes. Report finite-frequency differences without a parity threshold.
